content: Write the onboarding section of the README: how to install the CLI, authenticate, and run the first sync.
Drafted three short subsections with copy-paste commands and a troubleshooting note for expired tokens.
Our protein expression yield in the 37 degree cultures is low. Propose a screening plan over induction temperature, IPTG concentration and harvest time to raise soluble yield.
A 3x3x2 screen: 18, 25 and 30 degrees; 0.1, 0.5 and 1.0 mM IPTG; harvest at 4 and 16 hours. Measure soluble fraction by SDS-PAGE densitometry and fit a response surface to pick the next conditions.
best predicted: 25 degrees, 0.5 mM, 16 h; soluble yield +2.4x over baseline
